purpose: Teach: 古墳/打破/祈祷/側近/優等生/邦画/長嶋/乱入

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 地域の、本気で、絶対、古墳、絶対、保護、絶対、当社、絶対、協力しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: We must protect the local burial mounds with absolute commitment — it's essential our company cooperates fully. I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Commanding but measured. Short, decisive attacks on each point. Weight behind the directive. Not cruel, but brooking no question. Steady eye contact delivered.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市場の、本気で、絶対、停滞、絶対、打破、絶対、新製品、絶対、投入しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're breaking through market stagnation right now with new product launches. I appreciate your guidance.
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment. Clipped, efficient cadence. Slight formal lift at the close. Reporting completed work with quiet pride, not seeking praise.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 創業祈祷、本気で、絶対、地域の神社で、絶対、毎年、絶対、行え、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: The founding-day ceremony at the local shrine — I need that done every single year. This is non-negotiable.
lines.style: Grave and deliberate. Slight pause before 'every year' — letting the repetition sink in. The tone of someone speaking about tradition that outlasts individuals.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。会長の、本気で、絶対、側近、絶対、社員、絶対、人材育成、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. The executive vice president's team is actively developing our personnel. We're committed to that work.
lines.style: Affirmative tone. Steady, almost rhythmic delivery — a report delivered with competence. Slight formality at the close. Not embellishing, just confirming.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の、本気で、絶対、優等生、絶対、企業、絶対、目指せ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I want us to be the industry's model company. That's the standard. Make it happen.
lines.style: Direct and unadorned. Clipped phrases. The cadence of someone used to being obeyed. No softening. Final consonants crisp. The weight of expectation wrapped in few words.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、邦画、絶対、制作、絶対、協賛、絶対、しております、本気for、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're actively sponsoring Japanese film production. We're proud of that commitment.
lines.style: Formal, steady delivery. Slight warmth creeping in at the mention of the sponsorship — something Hiroshi cares about beyond the directive. Measured pace, clear articulation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: プロ野球の、本気で、絶対、長嶋、絶対、関連、絶対、当社、絶対、広告、絶対、検討しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Look into sponsorship opportunities around professional baseball and the Nagashima legacy. Explore what makes sense for us.
lines.style: Deliberate and thoughtful. Not barked — reasoned. Slight pause before 'Nagashima' as if recalling something specific. The tone of a strategic thinker, not just a delegator.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社施設への、本気で、絶対、乱入、絶対、対策、絶対、警備、絶対、強化しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We've strengthened security protocols at our facilities against unauthorized access. The measures are in place.
lines.style: Formal completion-report tone. Each clause delivered with professional closure. No hesitation. The quiet assurance of someone reporting that a problem has been solved.
